hook.name: HappiUniswapV4Hook
hook.description: Singleton Uniswap v4 hook shared by all Happi v2 graduated meme-coin pools. Takes a fee (hookFeeBps + creatorTaxBps) on every swap via afterSwap with a return delta, batches memecoin-denominated fees, and converts them to the pool's quote currency via an internal swap before distributing to protocol and creator via a shared fee escrow.
